# Plugin Forge

Generate plugin manifests and coordinate releases across coding agents.

| Maintenance | Dormant |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.2.17 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/plugin-forge) |

**Dormant:** Available as-is, with no planned updates. Existing releases remain installable.

## Example request

> Inspect this Forge-managed plugin and explain any manifest drift.

## Requirements

Python-based local authoring tool. Client installation details can drift as host applications change.

- Python 3.11 or newer
- uv and Git
- A plugin repository using forge.yaml

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add plugin-forge@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install plugin-forge@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Use an existing Forge-managed plugin repository and inspect its status before compiling.
- Forge still covers cross-provider authoring and release metadata. Native client plugin managers overlap with its installation functions.
- For this marketplace, run its catalog generator after changing the registry; do not hand-edit generated catalogs.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\plugin-forge
/reload
```
